editorial.copyrightPolicy: Publisher article text is never copied; Swoon'd writes its own explanation in its own words and links to the original publisher. No wagering content.

masteryModel.usefulCompetenceStatement: Can follow a game with a fan, decode common fan talk, and ask a meaningful follow-up question.

licensingConstraints.constraint: No NFL, NCAA or team logos, wordmarks, uniforms or the Lombardi Trophy design; team and league names as plain text only.
All diagrams and illustrations are original Swoon'd (license id original-swoond); no stadium or player photos.
No headshots, likeness or jersey-number-plus-name graphics; player names appear as text facts only.
No game footage, highlights or broadcast clips.
Referee announcements are original recordings (original-swoond); no NFL Films, broadcast or stadium audio.
Publisher text is never copied; explain in our own words and link.
Follow each provider's licence and attribution rules; no unofficial or reverse-engineered endpoints (for example no unofficial ESPN API).
No wagering, odds, props or fantasy-for-money content.

safetyConstraints: No real-world risk activities; the course never encourages imitating hits or tackles.
Discuss injuries and concussions respectfully; never as game outcomes or jokes.
No wagering or gambling content or links.
